decisions.reason: The account profile and audience-routing instructions do not change which source material or moments must be selected for clips.
The source explicitly adds a publication-level rule that every published clip should direct viewers to Teyron's main Instagram account.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey,

I need you to set up a dedicated Instagram account for publishing clips before you begin clipping. Follow these steps exactly:

1\. Using [FREELANCER_NAME_005] phone, create a brand-new Instagram account
2\. Choose a username along [FREELANCER_NAME_002] lines of: [ACCOUNT_001] / teyronclips / teyron.moments / [URL_006] — it should come across as an official content page
3\. For [FREELANCER_NAME_002] profile picture, select Teyron's photo or logo
4\. Use a bio similar to: "Best moments from Teyron Alexina — Follow [FREELANCER_NAME_002] main page [HANDLE_002] for more"
5\. Put [FREELANCER_NAME_002] link to his main Instagram in [FREELANCER_NAME_002] bio
6\. Send me [FREELANCER_NAME_002] username and password, along with [FREELANCER_NAME_002] email used to create [FREELANCER_NAME_002] account

Every clip you publish should direct viewers straight to his main page. [FREELANCER_NAME_002] objective is to build an audience that follows [FREELANCER_NAME_002] real account.

value_updates.audience_routing_rule: Every published clip should direct viewers straight to Teyron's main Instagram account.

decisions.reason: Creating and styling the dedicated account does not alter tracking coverage, tracked metrics, or transparency.
The dedicated-account and audience-routing instructions do not change the completed extended-trial batch requirements.
The source specifies how Instagram publications should route viewers but does not remove or change the existing Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok targets.
Account setup and audience routing do not change the required completeness, educational value, or standalone comprehension of clip moments.
The source concerns ongoing Instagram publishing setup and does not change the earlier three-clip trial.
The new audience-routing instruction applies to published clips but does not change approval authority, quota counting, rejection handling, or the existing prepublication gate.
The source does not specify or revise caption color, font, or effects.
The dedicated-account instructions do not change the 45–60-second clip-duration requirement.
The source does not change the requirement for effective clip hooks.
The account's official visual presentation is distinct from the clips' editing style and effects policy.
